text: The blood work shows leukocytosis and anemia with normal metabolic panels; do you have a history of smoking or recent exposure to industrial chemicals like benzene? REQUEST IMAGES: Peripheral_Blood_Smear.

speaker: Patient
text: 72-year-old male. The patient reports a 6-month history of fatigue and an unintentional weight loss of 5 kg (11 lb) despite maintaining a good appetite. He denies any recent changes in his diet or physical activity. He takes no medications and does not smoke or use illicit drugs.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; given your age, weight loss, and the blood smear results, are you experiencing easy bruising, bone pain, or night sweats? REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_Blood_Smear.
